'''Thalassia''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Thalassian system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was one of the slavery capitals of the outer rim and the location of the [[Thalassian slavers/Legends|Thalassian slavers]]' base of operations and the home planet of the [[Thalassian/Legends|Thalassians]].
